summary: Verified withdrawal settings persistence fix and Crypto Auto-Activations enrichment (email + EasyChange txn id) end-to-end. Backend pytest regression (test_withdrawal_settings_persistence.py) passes both cases. E2E via Playwright confirms: (1) After PUT /api/admin/settings/withdrawal with allowed_days=[1,3,5], open_time=08:30, close_time=18:45, the Admin > Réglages screen hydrates identical values (previously silently reset to defaults). (2) Toggling day 0 ON + changing hours in UI and clicking wd-save persists to DB (GET returns allowed_days=[0,1,3,5], open=09:15, close=19:30). (3) In Activations tab, crypto_auto rows expose 'CRYPTO AUTO' badge, 'E-mail' KV, and 'ID Transaction EasyChange' KV with admin-copy-easychange-<id> testid (22 visible rows). Search box admin-activations-search matches by activation id substring; the search field is wired to filter txid too. Restored production defaults (allowed_days=0..6, 00:00-23:59).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx admin file is very large (>3000 lines); consider splitting the Réglages / Activations / Withdrawals sections into sub-components for maintainability.

Frontend calls GET /api/admin/activations?status=<v> where the backend accepts one of {pending_payment,active,completed,cancelled,all}. Some filter strings returned 0 rows in my test session while default UI showed 22 rows — confirm the initial actFilter matches a supported value to avoid empty-first-load.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Withdrawal settings live under Admin > 'Réglages' tab (tab key = 'payment' in code, label 'Réglages'). Withdrawal settings restored to allowed_days=[0..6], open_time='00:00', close_time='23:59', fees=0. Regression backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_withdrawal_settings_persistence.py.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /app/frontend/app/(admin)/index.tsx load() at ~line 284 only hydrated fee fields (fee_percent/fee_flat/min/max/enabled) from the GET /api/admin/settings/withdrawal response, silently resetting wdAllowedDays/wdOpenTime/wdCloseTime to defaults. On save the PUT sent the defaults, giving the illusion changes did not persist even though backend was correct. Fix now hydrates all three fields, so admin edits round-trip correctly. Enrichment: izichange.create_activation_payment now stores email + provider_intent_id on the activation doc, and admin_list_activations enriches crypto_auto rows with easychange_transaction_id + email so ops can trace payments on the EasyChange dashboard.
